content: Langfuse official docs describe Langfuse as open-source, self-hostable, and extensible. Self-hosting can run via Docker/VM for low scale or Kubernetes/cloud Terraform for production; architecture includes application containers, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis/Valkey, S3/blob storage, and optional LLM gateway. SDK docs list Python and JS/TS SDKs plus OpenTelemetry/public API for other languages.
